shaSeparation.note: Three-way SHA separation per the established R3.0 convention.
shaSeparation.reviewedCandidateNote: Filled after Codex E2 PASS verdict against a specific candidate SHA. Tier 1 raw evidence: governance/r3.0e/codex-checkpoint-evidence/E2/round-N-<sha>.raw.txt.

contractEnforcements.storeScope: renderer/js/r3-0e-stores.js exposes createExperimentStore / createOutcomeStore / createTimelineStore / createFollowUpLinkStore / createStoreMetadata. Each factory takes a backend (matching the R3.0B createCaseStore convention: backend.transact(stores, mode, work)). Stores: r3_0e_experiments / r3_0e_experimentsIndex / r3_0e_outcomes / r3_0e_outcomesIndex / r3_0e_timelines / r3_0e_followupLinks / r3_0e_followupLinksByCase / r3_0e_storeMetadata.
contractEnforcements.writeValidation: Every create / update / appendEvent validates the payload against the E1 contract before write. Invalid payload → reject with R3_0E_*_INVALID + the contract reasonCodes.
contractEnforcements.readValidation: Every get / list re-validates against the E1 contract on read. Corrupted record → R3_0E_*_CORRUPTED. Future schemaVersion → R3_0E_*_FUTURE_SCHEMA (fail-closed — caller cannot accidentally treat a future-version record as current).
contractEnforcements.idempotency: Duplicate create → R3_0E_*_ID_COLLISION. Same-token re-write of timeline event → R3_0E_TIMELINE_DUPLICATE_EVENT.
contractEnforcements.staleGeneration: Experiment update with mismatched createdAt → R3_0E_EXPERIMENT_STALE_WRITE (optimistic concurrency on the immutable createdAt anchor).
contractEnforcements.appendOnlyTimeline: Timeline events are append-only. Existing events are NEVER overwritten. A correction is expressed as a NEW event referencing the prior event id (semantic enforcement at E4).
contractEnforcements.rehydrationAuthority: Persisted records DO NOT carry runtime authority (WeakSet identity cannot survive reload). Rehydration MUST re-validate via the E1 contracts and re-register with the appropriate runtime authority registry BEFORE downstream consumers treat the rehydrated value as authoritative. The store layer does NOT export WeakSet, register function, secret, or signing capability.
contractEnforcements.r3bUntouched: The R3.0B portable case-record schema body remains unchanged. The pre-existing R3.0B associations `experimentId` and `followUpCaseIds` are id-only refs; E2 does not introduce R3.0E-specific fields into renderer/js/case-record-schema.js. Test G1 / G2 confirm case-record-schema.js does NOT require r3-0e-stores.js and does NOT embed E2 store names.
